subject: Re: Follow-up: Security/compliance & subprocessor details for AcmeCorp evaluation
messages:
From: Samantha Hayes <samantha.hayes@acmecorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + security discovery follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the demo earlier. Good overview; our engineering and security teams want to make sure we understand data flows and third-party dependencies before we move to a POC. A few initial asks: 

- SOC 2 status and latest report availability (attestation vs. report)
- Primary cloud providers and any subcontractors that might see customer content (e.g., logging, analytics)
- Whether Redwood supports a customer-managed KMS for keys or uses your managed KMS
- A short subprocessor list (name + reason for access + region) we can share with procurement

Can you also kick off the vendor security questionnaire we sent? I’ve attached the spreadsheet; if you want, we can limit it to the InfoSec and Legal tabs for now.

Next steps: we’re aiming to have an internal sign-off checklist completed by end of next week (Feb 21).

Thanks,
Samantha Hayes
Security Program Manager
AcmeCorp
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Hayes <samantha.hayes@acmecorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + security discovery follow-up

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the quick notes and for sharing the questionnaire. Appreciate the timeline; we’ll do our best to support the Feb 21 internal milestone. Quick recap of what we can deliver this week:

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) in Q4 2025. We can provide the SOC 2 report under NDA; I’ll attach a redacted SOC 2 summary for the team to review (SOC2-summary.pdf).

2) Subprocessors & cloud providers: I’m attaching our current subprocessor export (redwood-subprocessors-v1.csv). High-level: AWS (EC2/EKS/S3) for compute and storage, GCP for some analytics pipelines, Datadog for monitoring, Sentry for application errors, and Segment for anonymized usage telemetry. The CSV includes reason and region.

3) KMS: We support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For our hosted offering there’s an option to use customer-managed KMS for encryption of customer-specific artifacts; we can share the integration notes for your security team.

4) Questionnaire: Laura will take point on the vendor security questionnaire and track open items with your InfoSec lead (I’ve cc’d her).

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to fill InfoSec and Legal tabs in the spreadsheet and return by Wed (Feb 18).
- Rishi to schedule a short tech dive (30 min) on data flows and key management for Thu (Feb 19).
- Marissa to provide the SOC2 NDA link and redacted report by end of day Mon (Feb 16).

Let me know if that plan works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Hayes <samantha.hayes@acmecorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + security discovery follow-up

Hi Samantha —

I started populating the vendor security questionnaire (see attached vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx). Key notes so far:
- SOC 2: See summary in SOC2-summary.pdf; full report available via NDA (link below).
- Data retention and deletion: Redwood offers configurable retention per-customer; default retention for hosted logs is 90 days unless otherwise specified. We can provide a deletion workflow and audit trail for your Legal team.
- Third-party access: Only a small set of subprocessors see customer content; rows in the attached CSV flagged as "content-access" indicate components that can access customer-provided inputs/outputs.

Outstanding items for your team:
- Confirm whether Acme requires a full SOC 2 Type II copy (we’ll share under NDA) or the redacted summary is sufficient for initial review.
- If you require customer-managed KMS for hosted, please confirm the desired key provider (AWS KMS vs. Azure Key Vault) so Rishi can prepare integration notes.

I’ll continue filling the spreadsheet and expect to have the InfoSec tab complete by end of day Thu (Feb 19).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Liu <tom.liu@acmecorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Samantha Hayes <samantha.hayes@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + security discovery follow-up

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from procurement and our cloud team: 

- Procurement: we’ll need the subprocessors list as a CSV with columns: name, service, data_access_level (none/pseudonymous/plaintext), region, contract_link. Can you confirm the CSV you shared has those columns?
- Cloud team: we prefer AWS KMS for BYOK; can you confirm Redwood has an AWS KMS integration path for hosted customers and any known limitations?

Procurement also asked for an estimated timeline for receiving the SOC2 report under NDA. If you can share an NDA link today, we’ll review and sign.

Tom
Head of Cloud Engineering, AcmeCorp
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Tom Liu <tom.liu@acmecorp.com>, Samantha Hayes <samantha.hayes@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security/compliance & subprocessor details for AcmeCorp evaluation

Hi Tom / team —

Thanks — quick answers and next steps: 

- Subprocessors CSV: Confirmed. I regenerated the CSV with the requested columns and attached it to the Doc (redwood-subprocessors-v1.csv). Columns included: name, service, data_access_level (none/pseudonymous/plaintext), region, contract_link. Let us know if you want an additional column for "legal_contact" or "last_audit_date".
- AWS KMS: We support AWS KMS for BYOK for hosted customers; there are documented limitations (key rotation windows and supported regions). Rishi will include the integration notes and known caveats in the tech dive on Thu.
- SOC2 NDA: NDA link attached: https://redwood.ai/ndas/acme-soc2-2026. Once signed we’ll send the full Type II report; typical turnaround is same business day once NDA is complete.

Action items: 
- Laura: finalize questionnaire InfoSec tab by EOD Thu (Feb 19) and send back to Acme.
- Rishi: Tech dive on Thu Feb 19 10:00 PT (invite sent).
- Marissa: Provide final CSV and NDA link (done).

If those look good I’ll coordinate next week’s POC kickoff once procurement confirms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
